Hec dicit Dominus Deus ad Edom:: Thus saith the Lord God to Edom
Auditum audivimus a Domino et legatum mi: We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and he hath sent an ambassador to the nations: Arise, and let us rise up to battle against him
Ecce parvulum: Behold I have made thee small
ECCE PARVULUM TE: Behold I have made thee small
Superbia cordis tui extulit te, habitant: The pride of thy heart hath lifted thee up, who dwellest in the clefts of the rocks
and settest up thy throne on high
Quis detrahet me in terram ?: Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Si exaltatus fueris ut aquila et si inte: Though thou be exalted as an eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars: thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord
Si fures introissent ad te,: If thieves had gone in to thee
NONNE FURATI ESSENT SUFFICIENTIA SIBI: would they not have stolen till they had enough?
Quomodo scrutati sunt Esau ? Investigave: How have they searched Esau, how have they sought out his hidden things?
Usque ad terminos emiserunt te et omnes: They have sent thee out even to the border: all the men of thy confederacy have deceived thee
the men of thy peace have prevailed against thee
there is no wisdom in him
Numquid non in illa die: Shall not I in that day
dicit Dominus, perdam sapientes: saith the Lord, destroy the wise
et prudentiam de monte Esau ?: and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
DE MONTE ESAU: out of the mount of Esau
Et timebunt fortes tui a meridie ut inte: And thy valiant men of the south shall be afraid, that man may be cut off from the mount of Esau
Propter interfectionem et propter iniqui: For the slaughter, and for the iniquity against thy brother Jacob, confusion shall cover thee
and thou shalt perish for ever
In die cum stares adversus eum,: In the day when thou stoodest against him
quando capiebant alieni exercitum eius: when strangers carried away his army captive
et extranei ingrediebantur portas eius: and foreigners entered into his gates
Et non despicies in die fratris tui, in: But thou shalt not look on in the day of thy brother, in the day of his leaving his country
ET NON DESPICIES: But thou shalt not look on
Et non letaberis super filios Iuda: and thou shalt not rejoice over the children of Juda
eorum, et non magnificabis os tuum: their …: and thou shalt not magnify thy mouth
portam populi mei: into the gate of my people
in die ruine eorum neque despicies et tu: in the day of their ruin: neither shalt thou also look on
in his evils in the day of his calamity
Et non emitteris adversum exercitum: and thou shalt not be sent out against … army
neque stabis in exitibus ut interficias: Neither shalt thou stand in the crossways to kill them that flee
Et: and thou shalt not shut up
super omnes gentes. Sicut fecisti fiat t: upon all nations: as thou hast done, so shall it be done to thee
SICUT FECISTI FIAT: as thou hast done, so shall it be done
retributionem tuam convertit in caput tu: he will turn thy reward upon thy own head
bibent omnes gentes iugiter: so all nations shall drink continually
ET ERUNT QUASI NON SINT: and they shall be as though they were not
Et in monte Sion erit salvatio: And in mount Sion shall be salvation

et non erunt reliquie domus Esau quia Do: and there shall be no remains of the house of Esau, for the Lord

Et transmigratio exercitus huius filioru: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel, all the places of the Chanaanites even to Sarepta
